findings_and_questions.kind: recovered historical raw-producer finding independently connected to current bounded source, no duplicate count
findings_and_questions.contract: constrained_camera_look derives yaw and pitch from native camera and owner quaternion, divides each by checked LookDistribution, clamps each to the joint limit, then retains the semantic pair as raw Vec2 through guarded_camera_look Option and owner_look BTreeMap to the native Euler quaternion. The checked divisor remains typed; it is not an already checked angle erased by this result.
findings_and_questions.condition: Source-level semantic propagation candidate, not a demonstrated runtime failure. Raw native CharacterLook or owner quaternion may carry policies not established by the checked divisor. In particular, the server input route below checks and normalizes a player look request but does not prove every possible local/external producer or owner rotation valid.
findings_and_questions.future_direction: Compare existing candidate owners and explicitly model the actual derived yaw/pitch pair if its policy fits; preserve guard and posture gating, rear-hemisphere folding, divide-then-clamp order, fractional positive divisor, raw native NaN/Inf behavior and quaternion adaptation. Do not assume a finite-only Radians owner is compatible or create a duplicate owner without decision. Central owns identity and ledger.
relationships: Exact 774 F001 and CAMERA-ADM03-039/COV-0843 historical records survive separately, earlier supplier attribution and root owner decision remain; 059 L11 and L12 original-role bounded reads are distinct and found no historical new finding in these receipts. findings_and_questions.kind: current source nonfinding and open owner-admission question
findings_and_questions.contract: PlayerInputRequest carries Vec2 look. Client samples CharacterLook yaw/pitch, while the inspected server input handler rejects nonfinite look, normalizes yaw by rem_euclid, clamps pitch, constructs Radians and writes both into CharacterLook. CharacterLook is replicated and is a Bevy Ahoy type reexported via core.
findings_and_questions.condition: This establishes one accepted server input route only. Local controller updates, other writers, scheduling, non-player sources and complete owner-Transform/quaternion ingress were not inspected; no claim that all observed native quaternions/angles are finite or that a bad one reaches rendering.
findings_and_questions.future_direction: Record actual producers and ownership boundaries before imposing narrower numerical admission. Preserve the existing finite server input check and angle normalization where it applies.

findings_and_questions.contract: The procedural pass obtains current owner local Transform rotation, gates camera aim on raised guard and no posture transition, clamps distributed yaw/pitch to a configured nonnegative angular magnitude, retains the pre-look rotation and restores it before the apply pass in the chained PostUpdate schedule.
findings_and_questions.condition: This trace excludes nonfinite native input, incomplete entity lifecycles and arbitrary scheduling beyond the displayed chain. Division by a positive very small divisor can yield infinity for finite nonzero angle, but subsequent finite joint-limit clamping is directly present; the separate BodyAngle-before-clamp acceleration finding is not automatically this operation.
relationships: 059 Adler READ-L11-185 made the prior look/base restoration and fixed-tick readiness qualifications; this is independent current bounded source observation, not transferred review credit.

findings_and_questions.kind: previously noted conditional capture-readiness question, no duplicate count
findings_and_questions.contract: FixedTickPoseCache stores each currently queried MhrBone entity and Transform when the fixed tick changes, restores only cached entities on later renders at that tick, and clears whenever no fixed clock step is present. The bank key records tick and entity, not topology readiness or asset revision.
findings_and_questions.condition: A repeated fixed-tick evaluation must occur while a required bone or actor appears or changes identity after initial capture and before another invalidating clock state. The actual capture readiness/clock/asset lifecycle was not traced here. Live clock unset bypasses this path by source comment and branch; no ordinary live failure asserted.
findings_and_questions.future_direction: Relate capture readiness and asset/rig lifecycle to first complete sample before deciding whether invalidation, readiness gate or explicit pose identity is required.
relationships: Prior Adler READ-L11-185 recorded this exact readiness qualification; related separately authored P17 capture evidence is not claimed as this packet’s personal read.

findings_and_questions.contract: The configured field is named guarded_look_joint_count, but LookDistribution deliberately accepts any finite strictly positive fractional divisor. The resulting offset is applied to Head and NeckOne roles; the separate directional yaw has six per-role weights.
findings_and_questions.condition: Whether the scalar denotes a physical count, a calibration divisor, an expected total angle, or another authored policy is not proved by the name. The runtime supports fractional values by design and quaternion composition need not be naively additive. No mismatch or defective value asserted.
findings_and_questions.future_direction: Establish the actual intended distributor and geometry/rig contracts before changing types, counts, bounds, weights or operation order.

nonfindings: Finite strictly positive LookDistribution admits fractional values and does not promise a finite raw result for every native radian input; checked_nonnegative rejects NaN/Inf and zero is rejected separately.
Native look division is followed by a joint clamp before Euler conversion; do not infer the BodyAngle-before-clamp overflow path applies here.
Gate-disabled or missing owner/irrelevant bone modes use Option/continue in the shown source; no error-erasure defect demonstrated.
The individual old and current original look material ranges are text-identical; the full historical P16 and current files have different hashes and three changed line spans.
Player-input finite checks establish only one producer path, not complete CharacterLook/transform ingress.
Source-only test navigation lines are listed as singleton exposures; no test, fixture or runtime behavior was executed.

perspectives.producer-propagation: Historical F001 is still visible: semantic derived yaw/pitch pair crosses first-party helper, Option and retained owner map before native quaternion port; checked divisor itself is preserved.
perspectives.existing-type-owners: Compare angle-pair needs to existing scalar angle types with distinct units and finite policies; no name-only owner selection.
perspectives.admission: LookDistribution accepts finite positive fractional divisors; angle limit accepts finite nonnegative degrees. Player server path independently checks and normalizes native input; remaining source paths are open.
perspectives.invariant-operations: Keep atan2 rear fold, divide-then-clamp and final quaternion multiplication/normalization order. NaN/Inf at raw native boundary and tiny divisor are distinct from checked body-angle admission.
perspectives.aggregate-states: The apparent divisor count and the actual two recipient bone roles form a policy question; fixed tick, cached entity map and rig readiness form another, with no demonstrated live failure.
perspectives.type-ownership: The derived look pair and checked config divisor have different authority and semantics; avoid conflating them with world direction, body response angles or a generic finite scalar.
perspectives.redundant-authority: Retained look base is explicitly restored before the next look pass. FixedTickPoseCache captures a separate presentation-wide pose whose readiness and entity lifecycle still require a capture owner trace.
perspectives.behavior-preservation: Exact old/current look windows match while landing snapshots changed eager to lazy. Preserve raw native invalid behavior and original functional order; no blanket current equivalence claim.
perspectives.enum-shapes: WeaponGuardState and optional PostureTransitionState explicitly control the look mode; absent aim and missing bones are distinct options, with no proved better enum migration.
perspectives.derivability: Displayed typed scalar constructors use real finite and nonzero checks; no removable hand-written conversion or serialization proved here.
perspectives.type-granularity: Fractional divisor, degree magnitude, signed yaw/pitch and pose rotation answer different questions. Enforcing an integer joint count or finite-only angle pair would require policy evidence.
perspectives.magic-strings: Bounded look body has no semantic string dispatch; landing warning and telemetry tags are native diagnostics, not a proven bespoke identity.
perspectives.magic-numbers: Six action-yaw role weights, 0.35 multiplier, joint limit, signed rear fold and two neck/head recipients serve different roles; contextual review is required before changing weights or constants.
